notes.title: Feature Showcase | Labors and Boons
notes.content: [h3]Hey all,[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]In this update I show you two features of Sunset Sprout that are essential addition to the gameplay loop and are special to the game, here's the run down:[/h3][p][/p][h2]Labors[/h2][p][/p][p]Labors are Daily, Weekly, and 2Weeks long challenges where you have to plant a certain number of items to get rewarded with gems, it is one of the best ways to get gems in game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564684/65ad422706e6a5aed8ecd3e1409a73e25e424136.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Boons[/h2][p][/p][p]Boons are a substantial upgrades to your farm, giving you the ability to get more out of your farming, crafting and selling! you gain them by completing main quests with [b]Enid[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564684/bc861a0ba5453fbdbab6d3320b2895185bf876a0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]What are your thoughts? is there anything you would like to ask or add? lets have a conversation! [/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Wishlist [b]Sunset Sprout[/b] now![/h3][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Feature Showcase | Building and crafting
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Farmers! [/h2][p][/p][h3]Continuing where we left off last time, lets take a look at the [b]crafting, building and repairing features in Sunset Sprout![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]So, to craft something, you need to have a building built and repaired[/p][p][/p][p]and there are [b]two[/b] main ways you can get crating building in game; these ways are:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Repairing broken crafting stations:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564684/1b5875d22135719105c26fae0e4f449393526a6b.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Building new crafting stations from the building menu:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564684/6e9950c901c999860d3340eb3d69f351850dca83.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]and these are the two main ways you can craft items in Sunset Sprout, there is twenty building already in the game, with way more to come, stay toned![/h3][h1] 

Join the discord server for more Updated and direct contact with me.

See you in the next one; [b]Fontty[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
